ValidationRule.description: to lock account after its approved
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(( $Profile.Name ='Partner - Admin' || $Profile.Name ='Partner - User' || $Profile.Name ='Partner Community User'), TEXT(Approval_Status__c) ='Approved' , OR( Name != PRIORVALUE(Name) , TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) != TEXT(PRIORVALUE(CurrencyIsoCode)) , TEXT(School_s_Country__c) != TEXT(PRIORVALUE(School_s_Country__c)), Website != PRIORVALUE(Website) , Phone != PRIORVALUE(Phone) , Account_Manager__c != PRIORVALUE(Account_Manager__c), OwnerId != PRIORVALUE(OwnerId), RecordTypeId != PRIORVALUE(RecordTypeId) )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot Edit once account is Approved.
